title: Little House on the Prairie
description: Laura gets into a brawl with a woman she considers to be her rival and then leaves Almanzo.

title: Heartland
description: Amy and Ty argue over Ty's investment in a horse; Amy begins working with Prince Ahmed.

title: Heartland
description: After working with Ty and Caleb's barrel-racing horse, Amy competes in a high-stakes Futurity.

title: Heartland
description: When Amy returns from Europe, she struggles to adjust to life back at Heartland and in her relationship with Ty.

title: The Santa Suit
description: A corporate bigwig (Kevin Sorbo) learns valuable lessons when Santa Claus transforms him into his look-alike.

title: Merry Matrimony
description: After landing her dream job, a woman must work with her ex-boyfriend to organize a wedding for a fashion magazine.

title: The 5-Year Christmas Party
description: Told over the course of five years, two recent college grads find themselves drawn together year after year while working for a catering company that specializes in holiday parties.

title: All Saints Christmas
description: Lisette is a popular R&B singer who's getting ready to travel home to New Orleans for Christmas. When the media mistakes a photo of her with her ex as an engagement announcement, her family insists that he join her on the trip.

title: A Christmas Miracle
description: When her boss steals her idea for their magazine's cover story, Emma searches for a Christmas miracle to write about with the help of her son and the handsome staff photographer.

title: Christmas Comes Twice
description: When a Christmas carnival comes to town, a ride on the carousel transports a top newscaster back in time, giving her a second chance at love.

title: A Royal Corgi Christmas
description: The prince's Christmas gift for his mother, a corgi puppy, turns into a disaster when the dog misbehaves constantly. He turns to an American dog trainer for assistance and sparks begin to fly.

title: Christmas Bedtime Stories
description: When Danielle's husband goes missing in action during his deployment, she's left to raise her daughter on her own. Three years later, as she acclimates to life without him, she begins to tell her daughter bedtime stories about her father.

title: Memories of Christmas
description: When Noelle inherits her mother's house, she finds out that for the past few years her aging mother had been hiring professionals to decorate it for Christmas. Noelle tells the decorator that the deal is off, but he refuses to take no for an answer.

title: Mystic Christmas
description: A woman reconnects with the owner of a pizza shop while working at a rehabilitation center and aquarium during the holidays.

title: A Holiday in Harlem
description: Known for transforming fledgling businesses into moneymakers, executive Jazmin Carter returns to Harlem, N.Y., to celebrate Christmas in the neighborhood where she grew up.

title: Our Italian Christmas Memories
description: As their grandfather struggles with dementia, the Colucci siblings set out to re-create their late grandmother's legendary pasta sauce to help jog his memory.

title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered for Christmas
description: Postal detectives delay their own travel plans to help a little girl who wrote an urgent letter to God.

title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Christmas
description: When a New England Christmas decorating competition searches for the town with the most Christmas spirit, the mayors of East and West Riverton go all out to get their towns to the top of the holiday heap.

title: Confessions of a Christmas Letter
description: After years of losing her community's Christmas letter competition, Settie Rose hires Juan, a struggling novelist, to depict her dysfunctional family in the best possible light.

title: Jingle Around the Clock
description: Elle decides to reunite her friends for Christmas, but her plans are thwarted by an opportunity at work. She's forced to team up with Max, who has a different take on the holidays. As they work together, they find themselves falling for each other.

title: Enchanted Christmas
description: Interior designer Laura is sent to her hometown of Santa Fe, N.M., to remodel a landmark hotel in time for a Christmas Eve benefit dance performance. As Laura dives into the renovations, she discovers that a former love is the star of the benefit.

title: Christmas at Graceland
description: A working Chicago mom brings her kids with her on a business trip to Memphis so they can all visit Graceland during the week before Christmas. But she is thrown for a loop when she bumps into an old flame from her days as a singer in college.

title: A Christmas Treasure
description: After opening a 100-year-old time capsule, a woman meets a charming chef and wonders if she should move to New York and further her writing career.
